title: AgentDebugger — monorepo, DAP, native collaboration and session history

steps.title: Establish the AgentDebugger monorepo
steps.description: Organize the debugger components into the shared repository.
steps.done_when: The shared workspace builds and its component boundaries are documented.

steps.title: Define the shared API and TypeScript client
steps.description: Define the common API and the TypeScript client used by the interfaces.
steps.done_when: The interfaces can use the shared client against the agreed API.

steps.title: Migrate the backend connection to DAP
steps.description: Move debugger communication to the Debug Adapter Protocol.
steps.done_when: A client can connect, inspect a paused process, and continue execution.

steps.title: Record durable session history in the core
steps.description: Keep session events available after the live investigation ends.
steps.done_when: Recorded events can be read after reconnecting.

steps.title: Replace explicit handover with execution coordination
steps.description: Coordinate execution when multiple interfaces share a session.
steps.done_when: Clients can share a session without conflicting execution commands.

steps.title: Simplify the standalone WebUI
steps.description: Reduce the interface to the essential debugging controls and session context.
steps.done_when: The main inspection flow remains accessible with fewer controls.

steps.title: Add collaboration to the native VS Code debugger
steps.description: Connect the native editor debugging experience to the shared session.
steps.done_when: The editor can inspect and control the shared debug session.

steps.title: Browse and export ended investigations
steps.description: Review a completed investigation and export its recorded history.
steps.done_when: A completed session can be opened and exported.

steps.title: Update harnesses, package, and validate end to end
steps.description: Exercise the complete workflow and prepare the distributable package.
steps.done_when: The agreed end-to-end scenarios pass against the packaged version.
